svg.title: Human-led review, from papers to decisions
svg.desc: Five panels show human codebook development, adaptive PDF retrieval and identity checking, optional AI proposals, human verification in an authentic Agency workbench capture, and file-based reviewer collaboration. Orange denotes preparation and handoff; blue denotes evidence and feedback. The capture contains practice responses, not study outcomes.

g.text: The team chooses the sample and rounds.
Find and check the full texts
Match the paper, version and full text.
Choose the mode for each reviewer or round.
Check the evidence and record a judgment
Actual Agency workbench · practice responses saved separately
Independent mode omits AI and peer answers.
Keep the decision and its rationale.
Revisit affected work when rules change.
TALL: technology-assisted language learning · original studies
Agency: AI in education and learner agency · existing reviews
